title: Between The Lakes Bungalow | 9 mins to BNA
description:
Welcome to Hermitage! Close to the home of Andrew Jackson, and nestled between Old Hickory Lake and Percy Priest Reservoir there's tons to do and see! Go boating with the family or stay in and relax with all the retro games you could dream of, we'd love to have you come stay with us in our own little slice of Nashville. We've got comfy beds for the whole family, a game room downstairs, and plenty of parking for everyone. We are only 9 minutes from BNA and only 15 minutes to downtown.
